name: Nether Earth ZS Edition '99: level
summary: The built-in level: the scenery and base lists, the shape table and the 11 shapes BuildMap turns into the map.

labels.name: SceneryWest
labels.comment: The scenery of columns 0-255: 55 records (tile or shape, x, y) and the 0 that ends them

labels.name: SceneryEast
labels.comment: The scenery of columns 256-511: 4 records and the 0 that ends them

labels.name: BaseListWest
labels.comment: The bases of columns 0-255: the player's warbase at (18,8), $FF ends

labels.name: BaseListEast
labels.comment: The bases of columns 256-511: the enemy's warbase at (497,8), $FF ends

labels.name: LevelSpare
labels.comment: The rest of the lists' room: zero up to $BF9B

labels.name: ShapeWarbase
labels.comment: Shape 0: the warbase, 15 blocks of tiles $0F (height 7) and $10 (height 15) around the door

labels.name: ShapeFactory
labels.comment: Shape 1: the factory, tiles $0F at (x-2, y) and (x+2, y), $10 on the roof row y-2 at x-2, x, x+2

labels.name: ShapeTallWallV
labels.comment: Shape 4: four blocks of tile $12 (height 15) in a column

labels.name: ShapeTallWallH
labels.comment: Shape 5: four blocks of tile $12 in a row

labels.name: ShapeEdgeFence
labels.comment: Shape 6: four blocks of tile $15 (height 99, impassable) in a column: the fences at both ends of the map

labels.name: ShapeLowWallH
labels.comment: Shape 9: four blocks of tile $11 (height 7) in a row
115 zero bytes up to the main menu at $C100: room for a longer level, never read
